title: File explorer
brief: Fileflux file explorer, same Bolt family as DBFlux and ReqFlux: sidebar places (Home, Desktop, Trash, mounted volumes, favorites), central toolbar with current path and scoped search, icon grid and detail list views, reference image is a plain dark compact folder grid with blue icons and filenames underneath, no card borders. Brand colors reuse ReqFlux cobalt provisionally for family comparison — not an approved Fileflux identity.

artboards.title: Familiar grid
artboards.tradeoff: Conventional three-region explorer closest to the reference image; standard 290px sidebar leaves less room for entries

artboards.title: Detail list
artboards.tradeoff: Two-row toolbar puts the editable path first and rows carry full metadata; less iconic warmth, denser information

artboards.title: Compact grid
artboards.tradeoff: Proposed 220px sidebar and 88px tiles maximize visible items; tighter spacing, less breathing room

artboards.title: Refined shell
artboards.tradeoff: Breadcrumbs, name-only sidebar with volume usage, larger two-tone folders and image thumbnails, a details/preview panel and CRUD affordances (context menu, F2 rename, trash with undo); the inspector costs ~300px of grid width
